text: The tenderer must hold valid public liability insurance with cover of at least EUR 1,000,000.
The tenderer's equity ratio must be at least 20%.
Qualification requirements for personnel working on site.
Environmental management arrangements during the course of the work.
Compatibility of the building automation system (BACnet/Modbus).
Pricing structure (fixed price / unit price / time and materials).
Description of the tenderer's quality management system.
All prices must be quoted exclusive of VAT, in EUR.
Tenders must be submitted by e-mail to hankinta@rantatuotelogistiikka.example no later than 19 June 2026, 12:00 (Helsinki time).
Compliance of lift maintenance with applicable statutory requirements.
Power of attorney for the signatory, where the tender is not signed by a person holding the right to sign on behalf of the tenderer.
The tender should confirm the tenderer's registered business ID.
The tender should confirm the name of the contact person handling the contract during its term.
The tender must include a certificate confirming payment of the tenderer's taxes.
Tenderers are reminded to check that any certificates submitted alongside the tender remain valid through the contract start date referenced above.
